name: Quest log: quest levels reach the client again after a map change
contract: The Ascension client reads the level of each quest log slot from SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT_ADDON field 61 + slot; without it the log shows every quest as level 0 in grey. A far teleport, such as leaving a dungeon, creates the player object again on the client and drops those fields, so the server has to send them again once the character is on the new map. Quest 7 (Kobold Camp Cleanup) is accepted in Elwynn Forest, which sends its slot level once; teleporting to Kalimdor must send it again.

steps.label: Accepting the quest sends its slot level once
The new map sends the slot level again
